document.abstract: This standard defines a digital pink noise signal to be used in calibrating the sound pressure level and electroacoustic response of a cinema B-chain system. It also defines an example algorithm to generate compliant LPCM pink noise signals in DSP devices with sampling rates of 48.00 kHz and 96.00 kHz. It does not define pink noise signals that may be used for other purposes such as headroom, distortion, or other system measurements.
